summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` in package.json. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, opaque predicate objects) and downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` against a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation (`WV8StW(arr, n)` shifting a large mixed numeric/string array `n7gIxM`) and is not derived from the package's declared TypeScript sources — the dist/tsbuildinfo tree contains no corresponding math module. Executing under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime rather than Node evades Node-based install-time scanners. This fires automatically on `npm install` with no user consent. A React marketing-components library has no legitimate reason to fetch the Bun runtime at install time or to execute an opaque 727KB blob under it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
